question: Will Venice Token exceed $27.82 on CoinGecko at 23:45 UTC on 30 Sep 2026 (last published print at or before that time)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the governing CoinGecko USD price for Venice Token (VVV) at or before 2026-09-30T23:45:00.000Z is strictly greater than $27.82.
- "No": Wins if that same price is $27.82 or below.

Clarifications:
- The governing figure is CoinGecko's USD price for id "venice-token", taken as the last published data point at or before 2026-09-30T23:45:00.000Z in CoinGecko's historical market chart range for that window.
- If a data point exists at exactly 23:45 UTC, that point governs; otherwise the most recent earlier point in the series (which may be an hourly print such as 23:00 UTC) governs.
- CoinGecko is the measure. An exchange-specific pair such as Binance VVV/USDT can fall on the opposite side of the threshold.
